vocabularyNoResults: Try another name or broaden your filters.
vocabularyPractice: Try it at your own pace
vocabularyComfort: Use a comfortable range and available support. Stop if a movement hurts.
vocabularyPathHint: The reference is always available. Follow the learning path to unlock the related lesson.
emptyLibrarySubtitle: Start a lesson from Learn. Your progress will appear here.
alreadyCompletedToday: Already completed today — XP is earned once per day.
lessonSummaryFallback: Watch the movement, then copy it at a comfortable pace.
techniqueDetailsHint: Description, focus, breath, and energy guidance
workoutTimerToggleSemantic: Workout timer, {} seconds remaining. Double tap to start or pause.
exerciseSkippedReady: Skipped. Move to the next exercise when ready.
exerciseTimerComplete: Timer complete. Move to the next exercise when ready.
exerciseTimerInstruction: Start the timer and practice at your own pace. You can pause whenever you need a break.
nextLockedSemantic: Next step locked until the timer completes. Activate for skip option.
forgeCoreSubtitle: Assess your abilities. Practise at your level. Earn mastery through evidence.
forgeXpSeparate: XP celebrates participation. Belts recognise demonstrated skills, not time spent.
forgeCriteriaProvisional: FORGE criteria are a provisional teaching framework, not a validated universal dance ranking. Results are self-assessed; mobility and fitness never substitute for dance foundations.
forgeTransferDescription: Export your profile, preferences, lesson history, workouts, FORGE assessments, belts, practice log, programme enrolments and private media to one portable file. Nothing is uploaded. Device-only avatar files are not included. Previously deleted videos remain explicitly marked unavailable in backups.
forgeRestoreWarning: Restoring replaces this device’s progress and private media with the selected backup. Export your current data first if you want to keep it.
forgeTransferSuccess: Backup restored. Your progress is ready.
forgeExportSuccess: Backup exported or handed to your device’s save/share dialog.
methodLoadError: Your assessment history could not be loaded. It has not been reset or overwritten.
methodCurrentHelp: Each category stands on its own. A failed retest can lower current demonstrated capability; your earlier belt awards remain in your history.
methodSupportCategory: Support · scales practice, never gates belts
methodSupportHelp: Mobility and capacity help you scale practice to your body and readiness. Range, speed, impact and endurance do not gate any belt. Choose supported or seated alternatives freely.
methodBeltsHelp: All six core categories and an integrated assessment must meet the target level. Higher evidence covers lower levels; averages and XP never substitute for a missing category. These are self-assessed FORGE milestones, not a global dance rank.
methodNoAttempts: No assessments recorded yet. Explore a rubric, try its task, then record what you actually demonstrated.
methodSelfAssessed: Self-assessed · private to this device · independent of XP
methodAllBeltsEarned: All published FORGE milestones earned. Keep exploring and reassessing your current practice.
methodMarkHelp: Try the task before checking anything. Mark only the criteria you met today. Every criterion is required to pass; saving an incomplete attempt keeps a useful practice record, not an award.
methodNotesRequired: This rubric requires observation notes for a pass. For delayed recall, include learning and recall dates. Without notes, the attempt is saved as incomplete.
methodNotesHelp: Record your adaptation, one success and one next focus. For delayed recall, include the learning date and recall date. Notes are private, not coach verification.
methodConfirm: I performed this task and these selections describe what I demonstrated today.
methodPassPreview: All criteria selected: this will record a self-assessed pass.
methodIncompletePreview: Some criteria are unmet: this records an incomplete attempt and may lower current capability on a retest. Earlier awards stay earned.
methodSaveError: Your assessment could not be saved. Your selections are still here. Check device storage and try again.
practiceIntro: Your practice scales each category independently. These supplemental drills do not complete lessons, prove mastery or change your belt. Choose a comfortable range and stop for pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness.
practiceSaved: Practice saved to your private logbook.
practiceSaveFailed: Could not save. Retry when storage is available; if settings need reloading, choose them again. Details: {}
practiceLoadFailed: Could not load your local practice data. Nothing has been reset. Details: {}
practiceUnsaved: Unsaved practice result. Save or explicitly discard it before leaving or starting another drill.
practiceDiscardBody: This result has not been saved. Discarding loses its duration, attempts and reflection. Imported media will remain in your private library.
practiceGentle: Gentler day · smaller range, easier variants and more rest
practiceUnassessed: Not assessed · safe beginner exploration, not an earned level
practiceLessonLocked: The related lesson is still locked. Continue its learning pathway to unlock it; this standalone drill does not bypass lesson prerequisites.
practiceLessonLoadFailed: Lesson progress could not be loaded. Related lessons are unavailable until the learning library reloads; your practice drills remain available.
practiceLogIntro: Every saved attempt is kept, including repeats on the same day. Comparisons use the same drill variant, position, level and tempo. Duration, attempts and perceived effort describe practice, not objective skill or improvement.
practiceFilteredHistory: Showing only practice for this lesson or vocabulary item.
practiceRecordedMetrics: Variant {} · {} active seconds · {} BPM · {} attempts · effort {}/10
practiceNoComparable: No earlier comparable attempt at this variant and tempo.
practiceComparedWith: Compared with {} at the same variant and tempo:
practiceComparison: {} active seconds · {} attempts · {} perceived-effort points. Different duration can change effort; these differences are not a mastery score.
practiceDeleteBody: Only this attempt will be removed, not other repeats or your private media. This cannot be undone.
practiceNotesHint: What became clearer? What would you repeat or change next time? Maximum 10,000 characters.
practiceRpeHint: 1 means very easy; 10 means your maximum effort. This is a self-report, not a skill score or a target.
practiceReflectionInvalid: Enter a whole-number effort from 1 to 10 and keep notes within 10,000 characters.
mediaLibraryEmpty: No local videos yet. Import a video you have permission to use.
mediaPrivacy: Private on this device. Import your own or permission-cleared MP4, MOV or WebM video (20 MiB each; 100 MiB library). Browser storage can be cleared or evicted: export a backup to keep your evidence.
mediaDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete this local video? All practice and assessment links to it will become unavailable. Export a backup first if you need to keep it.
mediaMissing: This linked video is no longer on this device. Restore a media backup or choose another video.
mediaSizeError: Choose a non-empty video of at most 20 MiB. Trim or compress it before importing.
mediaQuotaError: The local library is full (100 MiB or 500 items). Export a backup and delete an unneeded video before importing.
mediaUnsupported: This video cannot be decoded on this device. Try an MP4 with H.264 video, or a browser-supported WebM. No unsupported import was saved.
mediaStorageError: The video could not be stored or loaded. Check available device space and browser storage permissions, then retry. No successful save is assumed.
mediaUnavailable: This video is missing, damaged or unsupported here. Restore your backup or import a compatible video.
mediaNotVerified: User-supplied evidence only. FORGE does not score this video or verify technique.
mediaRecordedPerspective: Recorded perspective only. Mirroring flips the image; it does not create another camera view.
playerOffline: Offline practice · time counts only while practising, after the four-beat count-in.
playerTarget: Suggested target: {} minutes. You may save a shorter practice.
playerGoalReached: Target reached. Save your practice or resume for more.
playerCueTiming: Cues follow the selected counts. Pause to review; independent mode hides guidance.
playerAudioError: Metronome audio is unavailable or blocked. Enable sound and retry, or explicitly mute to practise with visual counts.
playerTempoPause: Changing tempo or phrase pauses practice. Resume with a fresh count-in.
playerIndependentHelp: Hide cues and demonstrations. Keep the timer and optional metronome; test your own recall.
playerNoTeacherVideo: No teacher demonstration video is supplied for this drill. The written cues work offline. You can import a permission-cleared demonstration below.
playerSchematicHelp: Original front-facing schematic, not instructor footage and not a demonstration of every drill. Take a small step, shift weight gently, then touch the free foot beside it. Use support or seated side-to-side weight shifts if preferred.
playerSafety: Use a clear, stable space and a comfortable range. Stop for pain, dizziness or loss of balance. Practice time and self-reported effort are not proof of mastery.
programmesIntroduction: Choose a guided route through real lessons. Study at your own pace, practise, and assess your skills separately.
programmesSaveError: Your changes could not be saved. Please retry.
programmesPrerequisiteHint: Complete the prerequisite lessons before enrolling. Open a prerequisite to see the path to it.
programmesCompletionNotMastery: Studying a lesson records learning activity, not mastery. Practice logs and self-assessed criteria are separate evidence.
programmesAssessmentHint: Use this published rubric to check the intended skill when you feel ready. It is self-assessed, not coach-verified. Completing this programme does not award a belt.
vocabularyCategoryEvidenceHint: Category evidence applies to its published rubric, not mastery of this term or style. A later retest can change current capability; earlier attempts remain in history.
vocabularyNoPractice: No practice saved for this term yet.
